notes: The portable C++ scenario maps page-192 l99 directly to canonical §8.6. It sends a timestamped interaction while the receiver is unconstrained, requests Enable Time Constrained, and verifies the callback retains RECEIVE received-order and occurs before Time Constrained Enabled. A later timestamped interaction is delivered with TIMESTAMP received-order before the receiver's TAR(2) grant. The scenario does not prescribe a GALT formula, imply complete time-management coverage, or claim provider conformance.
